the effect of the incentive mechanism of ultimate shareholders on firm valuation.

the incentive effect is more pronounced in countries where the minority shareholder protection is weaker.

the ultimate shareholder's cash rights have positive effect on the firm value in Asian countries and this effect is stronger in civil countries.

ultimate shareholders' cash flow rights have a positive effect on firm value, and this effect is more pronounced in countries where minority shareholders are better protected.
